items:
'Betty' of Santa Rosa is a luxurious 6BR/5BA home in Blue Mountain/Santa Rosa Beach just minutes from the beautiful waters of the Emerald Coast. Boasting a private pool, private yard , and tons of amenities, this home is an oasis of relaxation and also the perfect setting for gatherings of friends, family and loved ones! What's more? Its only a 2 min walk to the beach!

A large backyard with an el fresco dining area, grill and plenty of grassy area for kids to run and play. The private, heated, salt water pool provides hours of entertainment, with pool chaise loungers for sunbathing, an outdoor dining table, Adirondack chairs, and a drink cart with ice bucket and an outdoor shower .
(The pool can be heated for an additional charge).

An array of beach gear has been provided for your convenience, Including Beach chairs, umbrellas, and a wagon. Pool and beach toys including balls, floaties, buckets etc. are also provided.

The first floor features an open floor plan living area encompassing the gourmet kitchen, the large living room, and a dining area. The Dining table seats 10-12, and the enormous granite counter/bar top seats an additional 6. Two high chairs are provided for additional seating for young children. The top-of-the-line kitchen is complete with stainless steel GE appliances including two refrigerators, two freezers, a built in wine cooler, two dishwashers, and all granite counter-tops. The kitchen is equipped with all the dishes and kitchen tools necessary for cooking and catering for your group (plenty of utensils, plates, glasses, serving platters, cookie sheets, oven safe dishes, toaster, coffee maker, electric hand mixer, mixing bowls, placemats etc.).
The living room features a flat screen TV for entertainment. A full bath services the first floor living area and a laundry room with GE appliances allows for on-site laundering.

The second and third floors host the homes luxury sleeping accommodations. The second floor Master Suite overlooks the rear of the property and features a private balcony, a King bed, a flat screen TV, a BluRay player, and a walk-in closet. The on suite Master Bath has a private water closet, a large jacuzzi tub, a stand-alone shower, and double sinks/vanities. The second floor also hosts a Queen Suite and Bunk room that share a balcony overlooking the front of the property. The Queen Suite has a queen bed, a flat screen TV, and a BluRay player. The Bunk Room is complete with a queen-over-queen bunk with a full size trundle, a flat screen TV, and a DVD player. A full bath with a shower/tub combo services the bunk room and Queen Suite.

The third floor mirrors the second floor, with the only exception being that the third floor front-facing balconies provide guests with stellar views of the Gulf of Mexico.

With six spacious bedrooms and over-sized living areas, this home is perfect for larger groups as it comfortably sleeps 20 guests.
The home also caters to the need of young ones. In total, the home offers one full size wooden crib, a fold up Pack n Play, one bassinette, 2 high chairs, and a booster seat.

Looking to head from the pool to the beach? A short stroll down a quiet road will have you with your feet in the sand in just two minutes, with no busy roads to cross. The Beach access features a picnic area, restrooms and water fountain for your convenience. Car and golf cart parking is available at the beach access, though not necessary for guests staying at Betty as its such a close walk.

Betty is also within walking distance of several local restaurants, Including Goatfeathers, Local Catch, Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar, The Perfect Pig and so many more (There is also a package store and pharmacy right there). One block away on the corner is a bike rental store and famous local ice cream store called "Under the Sea". They also rent Golf Carts, kayaks, and paddle boards. If you're Interested in a beach Bon fire, Momma Bear Beach Bonfires does an amazing job.
A little ways West (25 min) is the Destin area, which has a vast array of additional activities including deep sea fishing charters, water sports such as parasailing, jet skiing, snorkeling, mini golf, water parks and much more. If you're a shopping enthusiast, Destin Commons, Grand Boulevard and the outlet malls at Miramar will not disappoint!

Linens, Bath towels and a starter amenity kit are provided. We do not provide beach towels.

NOTE: Minimum age requirement to rent this house is 25 years of age. NO HIGH SCHOOL/COLLEGE SPRING BREAK PARTIES ALLOWED. NO events (Weddings etc). NO pets.

Parking: There is parking For 3-4 cars (One large space accommodates three cars and an additional space in front of the front door can accommodate a compact car).

Please Note: All credit card payments incur an additional 3% merchant processing fee. There are no fees for check or Venmo payments. If you prefer to pay via check or Venmo, please contact us after your booking.

Security Deposit: Please note that we charge an additional $500.00 fully refundable damage deposit for each reservation. The security deposit is refunded back 1-3 days after your stay as long as there are no damages to the property.

We require our standard rental agreement to be signed online by each group. The rental agreement is sent via DocuSign approximately 1 month before your arrival.

Security Cameras: We have outdoor security cameras at entry points at the property.

Located in Santa Rosa Beach, this vacation home is near the beach. While the natural beauty of Blue Mountain Beach and Grayton Beach State Park can be enjoyed by anyone, those looking for an activity can check out Sandestin Golf Resort - Raven, Burnt Pine, Baytowne, The Links. 
Traveling with kids? Consider Sundog Books and Sirens at the Beach. Discover the area's water adventures with jet skiing and kayaking nearby, or enjoy the great outdoors with hunting and hiking.
